description: This file contains a CMake function named 'json4' that parses a JSON-formatted input string and converts it into CMake data structures, including handling of JSON objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and nulls. The function employs regular expressions and CMake commands to tokenize the JSON and build a nested map representation.

methods.name: json4
methods.description: Parses a JSON string input and constructs a nested data structure within CMake, supporting objects, arrays, and primitive values.
